limitations: The declaration is a single entry number; it says where the trustworthy band begins, not why the entries below it fail.
A consumer with failures and no declaration changes from exit 0 to exit 1, including ledger_upgrade.upgrade, which will decline to swap.
This repository must declare 111 rather than 12 because entries #109 and #111 classify as failures, understating the chain by 81 measured verifying entries in the #12 to #108 span.
non_goals: Changing what counts as a failing entry; the classification loop is untouched.
Taint propagation in post-anchor mode; GH #430 suggestion 1 is measured contract-breaking and not adopted.
exclusions: GH #430 suggestion 3, surfacing the strict/post-anchor disagreement in governance_health.
Formalizing the Non-chain-advancing entry marker, undocumented and used on three entries.

phases: Phase 1: resolve the post-anchor boundary as explicit argument, then a declaration in .qorlogic/config.json read via qorlogic_config.load_section, then auto-detection permitted only when no entry classifies as a failure, then a fail-closed refusal naming the failing entries and the config key; declare this repository's boundary at 111; correct doctrine section 14 and the post-anchor boundary glossary definition
ci_commands: python -m pytest tests/test_post_anchor_verify.py tests/test_ledger_hash_duplicate_entry.py tests/test_ledger_hash.py tests/test_seal_entry_check.py tests/test_ledger_upgrade.py tests/test_governance_health.py -v
